com.esignal.jstandard.beans.requestoption

Class AbstractRangeRequestOption<E>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.requestoption.AbstractRangeRequestOption<E>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    RequestOption<java.lang.String>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    DbcPriceRangeRequestOption, DbcSizeRangeRequestOption, DbcValueRangeRequestOption

    public abstract class AbstractRangeRequestOption<E>
extends java.lang.Object
implements RequestOption<java.lang.String>
    AbstractRangeRequestOption is an abstract implementation of a RequestOption that allows ranges of values to be defined.

    Used to chain RequestOption objects of the same type together. Useful to provide range queries for filters such as Price, Size, and Value. To make a price request range of values between 100 and 200, or equal to 300 you will do something like this: 

     RequestOption price = new DbcPriceRangeRequestOption(OPERATORS.GREATER_THAN, 100);
 price.and(OPERATORS.LESS_THAN, 200);
 price.or(OPERATORS.EQUAL, 300);

    01-004-0003
